subject: Request: prompt/output/log clearance for Clearwell - next steps
messages:
From: Jamie Ortiz <jamie@clearwell.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: privacy@clearwell.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: purge of prompt outputs and related logs for account CLW-8892

Hi Mina / Evelyn,

Per our data residency review and the customer's signed deletion request (ticket CLW-8892), Clearwell needs Redwood to permanently remove all generated prompt outputs, associated inference logs, and any short-term KV cache artifacts tied to the account since onboarding. Scope we care about: prompt inputs/outputs, model chat transcripts, inference-to-backend logs, and per-request metadata (request IDs, timestamps).

Attached is an initial CSV with example request IDs and date ranges we expect to be removed (deletion_manifest.csv). We need a short, auditable handoff: a confirmation that the purge will run, the expected completion window, and a proof package (checksums + truncated logs showing deletion markers) once done. Are there any constraints from Redwood (retention windows, archived logs) we should be aware of?

Clearwell's compliance team is on a tight timeline and asked for evidence by end of week.

Thanks,
Jamie Ortiz
Head of Data Privacy
Clearwell Healthtech

Attachment: deletion_manifest.csv (CSV, 18 rows)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Ortiz <jamie@clearwell.com>, privacy@clearwell.com
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompt outputs and related logs for account CLW-8892

Hi Jamie — thanks for the manifest. We're prepared to run a targeted clearance for the listed request IDs and related artifacts. Quick summary of proposed approach: 

- Ops will schedule a dedicated purge job scoped to CLW-8892's objects (prompt outputs, inference logs, KV prefixes) and mark affected entries in our audit ledger.
- We'll capture a proof bundle containing: deletion manifest (server-side IDs), operation timestamps, job runner logs (truncated), and SHA256 of the exported evidence archive.
- Expected timeline: kickoff within 24 hours after written authorization from your side, completion and proof delivery within 48 hours of kickoff (barring backfills).

I've attached our internal SOP for record (SOP-delete-runbook.pdf) so you can see the safeguards and backup checks we perform. Two asks from our side before we run:
1) Please confirm an explicit authorization reply from an admin on your compliance team (simple reply: "authorize purge for CLW-8892").
2) Confirm whether Clearwell requires redaction of any retained telemetry we use for infra billing (we can exclude billing-only traces if requested).

Evelyn (CS lead) and Ben (Ops) are looped for scheduling and execution.

-Mina
Mina Haddad
Manager, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOP-delete-runbook.pdf (PDF, 14 pages)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jamie Ortiz <jamie@clearwell.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompt outputs and related logs for account CLW-8892

Following up with an ops note:

We can run an isolated purge job on our infra. Operational details:
- Purge will execute on the dedicated retention cluster for CLW-8892 to avoid cross-tenant impact.
- The run will delete prompt/output artifacts and redact associated inference logs. Full audit entries will be appended to our immutable ledger with deletion markers.
- Duration estimate: 2-3 hours for the baseline manifest; additional time if expanded ranges are requested.

I will need a one-line authorization from Clearwell to proceed (we cannot run without written consent). Once complete, I'll export the proof bundle to a signed artifact (purge-evidence-20280621.tar.gz) and post the SHA256.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Jamie Ortiz <jamie@clearwell.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: privacy@clearwell.com
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompt outputs and related logs for account CLW-8892

Authorize purge for CLW-8892.

Please proceed with the run against the manifest attached earlier. Clearwell confirms we do NOT need infra billing traces redacted; keep them for your internal accounting. We require the proof bundle to include:
- job run ID and start/finish timestamps
- list of server-side IDs deleted
- a signed SHA256 for the evidence archive
- redacted log excerpts showing deletion markers (no full payload)

Ticket: CLW-8892. Clearwell expects the completed evidence by close of day Thursday. Let me know immediately if there are blockers.

Jamie Ortiz
Head of Data Privacy
Clearwell Healthtech
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Ortiz <jamie@clearwell.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompt outputs and related logs for account CLW-8892 — proof delivered

Jamie — job completed and evidence package uploaded. Summary: 

- Job run ID: RUN-20280621-CLW-8892-03
- Start: 2028-06-21T12:05:18-07:00
- Finish: 2028-06-21T14:21:42-07:00
- Objects removed: 1,042 prompt/output artifacts, 7,120 inference log entries (redacted), KV prefixes cleared (tenant-scoped).

Proof bundle: purge-evidence-20280621.tar.gz (SHA256: b3f5a8c2f7d9a6c9a1d4f2e5c6b3d4e5f7a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3)
Contained files (truncated for email):
- deletion_manifest_server_ids.csv (list of server IDs removed)
- audit_ledger_entries.txt (append-only entries with deletion markers)
- log_excerpt_redacted.txt (timestamps and deletion markers; payloads redacted)
- checksums.txt (SHA256 of included files)

Attachments were uploaded to our secure transfer link: https://redwood.app/ops/tickets/TCK-4782/attachments/purge-evidence-20280621 (authenticated link).

If you confirm receipt and that the bundle satisfies Clearwell's audit needs, we'll mark CLW-8892 as closed and record the action in the compliance ledger. Happy to schedule a short call if you want to walk the evidence together.

-Ben
Senior Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: purge-evidence-20280621.tar.gz (archive, 4.1 MB, stored on secure transfer)
